The ACVP fixtures are byte-for-byte decodings of hexadecimal fields from NIST's SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s sample vectors. Filenames give the mode, test case ID and field. The pure external signing case is hedged. Verification case 266 is valid, and case 253 has a modified signature randomizer. These extracts were made on 2026-11-26. See [NIST ACVP-Server at the source revision](https://github.com/usnistgov/ACVP-Server/tree/112690e8484dba7077709a05b1f3af58ddefdd5d/gen-val/json-files) and [the NIST notice](COPYRIGHT.txt).

For the Jazz fixture, the commitment seed is the 32 bytes from 00 to 1f. Python's hashlib.blake2b with digest_size=32 produced the first 16 bytes under each of the three zero-terminated labels, concatenated in SK.seed, SK.prf, PK.seed order. From those bytes, fips205 0.5.0 produced the public key and deterministic signature of the UTF-8 message `endorsement fixture` under the context `jazz.e2ee.endorsement.v1`.
